name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

eligibility.other_conditions: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) for the first and second child (if girl child).

benefits: Maternity financial assistance of Rs. 5000 in two installments for the first child, and Rs. 6000 on birth of a second girl child.
application_process: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility within 570 days of LMP.
Submit Form 1A along with Aadhaar and MCP Card.
Installments are credited directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
